items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: Eddie Dawson used to play with me.

ctx.x: Who was this Dorsey? Dorsey was a bass player. A bass player. Yes. It isn't Eddie Dawson, the one that we know Eddie. Eddie Dawson.
Eddie Dawson. Well Eddie Dawson used to play with me.
Eddie Dawson now you're talking about. No relation, not the same family.

items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Tom Albert told me about it. ... [INTERVIEWER] Tom Albert told me about that, you know, when he was young.

ctx.x: Sam, uh, Sam Moran was a bass player. Now, he played, he played X-ray with Tom Brown at, uh, at Tom Anderson. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. I, I, I believe I, I took, I took his place one time, and I remember the last, the last winding up of, of Tom Anderson, uh, Sam Moran got his, health got bad. And he's living on Gascon Street. And his health got bad, and they had to put me on the bass. Mm-hmm. And I went with Charlie, with Tom Brown. We had Frank Keelan playing trumpet with us then. Yeah. Frank Keelan. Frank Keelan. I'll…
Did they have, uh, two drummers in those times? I mean, before they had the foot pedal, do you remember them? Yeah. Tom Albert told me about it. They always had foot pedals?
Oh, all the time. They always had foot pedals. One guy played a snare drum, played a bass drum, at the same time.
